messages.subject: Pricing / overage charges
parts:
I am considering purchasing the standard plan for my organization and have a couple of questions:
  • Is it possible to purchase the plan for 3 years in advance? If so, is there any discount for advance payment? Would it be possible to send a quote for a 3-year purchase?
  • Is there a way to eliminate the possibility of overage charges? My organization can only pay in advance and will not have access to funds to pay any potential overage charges. We would prefer to simply terminate sessions if the total active hours limit is exceeded.
